tool_input.description: Read build gate record and logs

result:
The test gate passed. Next step is `/sdlc-deploy 0004`, which the workflow starts on its own.

I did not run build, test or lint myself in this session. It is a CI session where those three commands run after the session ends, so `test.log`, `build.log` and `lint.log` only hold a "deferred to the runner" note for now. That's why I have no output of my own to paste. The runner's results will update those logs and the `sdlc/test` check, and if anything is red there the change is parked for a fix. The last real run was on the build commit (`1044038`): 152 tests passed, compileall printed nothing, and ruff printed `All checks passed!`. The source code hasn't changed since then; only files in the change folder have.

- **Verifier (fresh context):** it says the change matches the plan. All 19 tests listed in `plan.md` exist, and the worked example matches the spec's numbers to within 2.2e-16. `app/data/` is unchanged, the version is still 0.1.0, and `pyproject.toml` lists `app.backtest`. No wheel was built in this phase; the build phase already built one and listed its contents. The report is in `evidence/verifier.md`.
- **Adversarial review (Opus):** it says continue, and rates the change non-routine. No areas from the risk list were touched, so no panel was needed.
- **Gate result:** passed on every check. The commit is `3292c32` and it's pushed to `sdlc/0004/build`.
- **PR and check:** PR #22 is updated (https://github.com/luissiviero/crypto-backtester/pull/22), and the `sdlc/test` check reports success.

One thing you need to do: `CLAUDE.md` still describes only the data feature. `plan.md` has suggested wording for the new backtest feature, which you'll need to add in your own PR because a run can't edit that file. Until then, the deploy review may flag it, as it did on change 0003.
